newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Feed industry urges further grain price cuts.
newsitem.headline: Feed industry urges further grain price cuts.

text.p: European Union animal feed producers urged Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler to make further cuts in cereals prices so that livestock exporters could compete on world markets.
In a letter sent to Fischler on Thursday, the feed producers' organisation, FEFAC, said reforms started in 1992 to make agriculture more market-oriented, should be developed further.

"Increasing the competitiveness of livestock production in the EU requires the further downward alignment of the support price system for the major crops...," FEFAC, the feed producers' organisation, said in a press release.
FEFAC also called for a further shift towards more flexible income support which would enable farmers to grow crops in response to market needs.
It urged the European Commission to work with the compound feed industry, rather than against it, in promoting sustainable livestock production methods.
